facts.text: Undergraduates at UW Oshkosh are required to live in university residence halls for two academic years unless they have earned at least 48 credits or are 21 years of age.

sources.title: Off-Campus Housing Marketplace
sources.quote: Additionally, UWO will exempt anyone from the housing requirement if one or more of the following are true by the first day of a fall semester: * They have successfully earned at least 48 credits; * They are at least 21 years of age; * They have lived in a residence hall for four semesters;
sources.closest: exempted from the housing requirement by completing a commuter card. additionally, uwo will exempt anyone from the housing requirement if one or more of the following are true by the first day of a fall semester: they have successfully earned at least 48 credits; they are at least 21 years of age; they have lived in a residence hall for four semesters; they are married;

facts.text: Out-of-state freshmen with an unweighted GPA of 2.5 or higher qualify for the Titan National Scholar program, paying the Wisconsin in-state tuition rate.

sources.title: UW Oshkosh Nonresident Resources
sources.quote: Nonresident students who qualify will pay the in-state tuition rate (cumulative total of more than $30,000 in savings over four years).
